MORGAN J. CRAMER
President and Chief Executive Officer
P. Lorillard Company

Morgan J. Cramer, President (since July 13, 1961) and Chief Executive Officer (as of December 1, 1962) of P. Lorillard Company came to top position in America's oldest, and third largest, tobacco company through the ranks of the sales organization. While this is a traditional route to executive leadership at Lorillard, Mr. Cramer's 32-year career with the Company has been more than a following-in-footsteps: virtually every title he had before becoming President had to be created for him because it wasn't previously on the Lorillard organizational chart.
Selling cigarettes -- whether at field or executive level -- has taken him to virtually every corner of the United States and every part of the world. A familiar sight at Lorillard headquarters in New York -- until Mr. Cramer was drawn into top corporate responsibilities -- was the packed suitcase in his office, ready for the trip to Atlanta, San Francisco, Paris, Tokyo, or points east or west.
